To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

high-intensity interval walking exercise training is feasible and safe in patients with lung cancer, and that it is associated with significant improvements in cardiorespiratory fitness and health-related quality of life.
high-intensity interval walking training (HIIWT) is effective in deconditioned lung cancer patients and is safe.
HIIT improves exercise capacity and quality of life in deconditioned cancer patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of a high intensity interval training (HIIT) program on the health of patients undergoing surgery for lung cancer.
the effects of high-intensity interval exercise (HIIE) on the body composition and metabolic health of overweight or obese individuals.
the development and application of new methods of analysis for the study of high-intensity interval exercise training in the treatment of cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
high-intensity interval exercise training is effective in improving cardiorespiratory fitness and physical function in lung cancer patients undergoing surgery, and is well tolerated.
high intensity interval training is a safe and efficacious form of exercise for patients with COPD.
the current evidence is not sufficient to support the routine implementation of high intensity exercise interventions in patients with advanced cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method for the treatment of lung cancer that has been shown to be effective in a randomized controlled trial and that has the potential to be widely implemented.
we have shown that HIIT can be effective and safe for deconditioned patients undergoing lung resection surgery.
we are working on developing new and improved methods for the detection and treatment of cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the benefits of exercise are not only physical but also mental.
the combination of HIIT and strength training is more effective than either modality alone in improving fitness and reducing body fat, especially in those with higher body weights.
we need to think more carefully about how we are using our time.
